title: Radial pressureless Euler flow: structure and stability of absorption at the origin
summary: We study absorption at the origin in radial pressureless Euler flow in $\mathbb{R}^n$, $n\geq2$. For rotation-invariant nonnegative locally finite initial mass and bounded radial initial velocity vanishing at the origin, we prove global existence and uniqueness in a full-space radial entropy class with a one-sided Lipschitz bound and an initial kinetic-energy trace. Absorption is permanent, including retention of any initial origin atom.
